name: CloudFormation Security Review
description: Security review of AWS CloudFormation templates and stacks. Covers YAML/JSON template review for misconfigurations, stack policies, drift detection, nested stack security, custom resource risks, and evaluation of CloudFormation-provisioned infrastructure against security baselines.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to CloudFormation security review

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands CloudFormation concepts, template syntax, and common security concerns
evidence: Can explain CloudFormation stacks, templates, parameters, and outputs
Understands common CloudFormation misconfigurations and their security impact
Familiar with stack policies and drift detection concepts

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews CloudFormation templates under supervision using static analysis tools
evidence: Runs CloudFormation scanning tools (e.g., cfn-lint, cfn-nag, Checkov) under guidance
Identifies common resource misconfigurations using lab checklists
Documents CloudFormation security findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently reviews CloudFormation templates for security issues
evidence: Independently reviews templates for IAM, networking, and encryption misconfigurations
Evaluates custom resource Lambda functions for injection and privilege risks
Assesses parameter handling for sensitive data exposure
Produces compliant CloudFormation security review reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex nested stack reviews; develops custom rules; mentors others
evidence: Reviews complex nested and cross-stack reference architectures
Develops custom cfn-nag rules and Checkov policies
Reviews CloudFormation security work of junior analysts
Evaluates CloudFormation deployment pipeline security controls

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab CloudFormation review methodology; publishes IaC security research
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's CloudFormation security review framework
Published research on CloudFormation security risks or template injection techniques
Trains teams on advanced CloudFormation security review
Recognized as authority on CloudFormation security

assessment_methods.description: Review a set of CloudFormation templates with intentional misconfigurations and identify all security issues
Review CloudFormation security findings from recent IaC assessment engagements

cis: CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v5.0.0 - Sections 1-5 as template review baseline
